hadith:
Good Manners and Form (Al-Adab) - Narrated Sulaiman bin Surad:

A man from the companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Two men abused each other in front of the Prophet (ﷺ) and one of them became angry and his anger became so intense that his face became swollen and changed. The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "I know a word the saying of which will cause him to relax if he does say it." Then a man went to him and informed him of the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) and said, "Seek refuge with Allah from Satan." On that, angry man said, 'Do you find anything wrong with me? Am I insane? Go away!"
message: Every human being is created with purpose and dignity by Allah, the All-Powerful, progressing from a simple drop of fluid to a perfectly formed creation—so never despair about your worth or role in this life. When anger or conflict arise, remember to seek refuge in Allah from Satan's whispers, for patience and mindfulness of the divine bring peace to the troubled heart. Trust in Al Qaadir's complete control and wisdom over all matters, and you will find strength and purpose in submission to Him.
name:
Al Qaadir - الْقَادِرُ - The Powerful

The name Al Qaadir is derived from the Arabic root 'q-d-r', which denotes strength and capability. This name reflects the belief that Allah has complete control over the universe and is capable of exercising His will in all matters. It emphasizes the concept of divine power and authority in Islamic theology.
verse:
Al-Qiyamah - The Resurrection - 75:36-39

Do people think they will be left without purpose?

Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted?

Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form, producing from it both sexes, male and female.
